page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for data persistence. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. From a qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and high-density resource configuration position this instance for enterprise workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead.

The ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is suited for high-performance computing, large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, and distributed database nodes that demand dedicated CPU execution resources and substantial network throughput.
